It will be headed up by Kayleen Walters, a Lucasfilm veteran who moves over from her most recent post at Minecraft maker Mojang, for whom she was president – and also served as an executive producer on last year's A Minecraft Movie.

title: After a yearslong slump, China's real estate market may be set for a turnaround
snippet: A recovery in China's largest cities real estate markets could come as soon as next year, the S&P ratings agency said.

title: Huawei doubles down on smartphones as EV sales slow
snippet: Chinese tech company Huawei wants to rebuild its consumer business after U.S. sanctions halved segment revenue.

title: We spent thousands on a Tui river cruise but ended up on coach trips
snippet: Passengers have described their anger after their itineraries changed to involve hours spent on coach trips instead.

title: 'Come all the way' back to EU, French finance minister tells UK
snippet: Roland Lescure tells the BBC that being in the bloc enables members to better address the challenges facing the world.

title: The wildlife winners set to appear on your banknotes revealed
snippet: The decision comes after nearly half a million people voted on a shortlist of 18 creatures.

title: 'Stop throwing shade' - the woman trying to stop firms leaving the UK
snippet: British people need more incentives to invest in big firms listed in the UK, Dame Julia Hoggett, boss of the London Stock Exchange, says.

title: Fed officials see another hike coming, but no sign as to when, minutes show
snippet: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its Sept. 15-16 policy meeting.

title: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva
snippet: Kristalina Georgieva warns that the technology lifting growth hopes is also pushing up inflation and yields, just as public debt levels rose.

title: Chart: A look at the S&P 500's remarkable and defiant trip to a new record
snippet: The S&P 500 returned to an intraday record Tuesday as tech gains, easing oil prices and Treasury yields helped stocks overcome months of market shocks.

title: How event contract bundles are boosting volume on prediction markets
snippet: Combo contracts are driving volume growth even as they make up a small, albeit consistent, share of transactions.

title: Kalshi, Polymarket trading volumes on some products raise questions amid massive growth
snippet: Unusual trading patterns on Kalshi and Polymarket are drawing scrutiny as experts debate whether reported volumes reflect organic market activity.

title: Goldman: Diesel prices set to stay high through 2027 as refineries struggle to meet demand
snippet: Goldman Sachs says tight refinery capacity could keep diesel prices elevated through 2027, with high margins needed to curb demand and rebuild inventories.

title: House Democrat targets candidate prediction market trades after opponent’s Kalshi penalty
snippet: A new bill bans federal candidates from trading prediction market contracts related to their own elections and would result in a fine if violated.

title: Brazilian stocks jump as Bolsonaro now seen as heavy favorite to win presidency
snippet: The moves come after the first round results of Brazil's presidential election on Sunday. Bolsonaro will face incumbent Lula da Silva in a runoff on Oct. 25.
